mapper.sql: user_account.id AS id, user_account.company_id AS company_id, user_account.username AS username, user_account.name AS name, user_account.email AS email, user_account.actor_type AS actor_type, CASE WHEN user_account.company_id IS NULL THEN 'WorkOps' ELSE company.name END AS company_name, CASE WHEN user_account.department_id IS NULL THEN '未設定' WHEN department.is_deleted = TRUE THEN CONCAT(department.name, '（削除済み）') ELSE department.name END AS department_name, COALESCE(( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(permission_set.code, ' / ', permission_set.name) ORDER BY permission_set.id SEPARATOR ', ') FROM user_permission_sets user_permission_set INNER JOIN permission_sets permission_set ON permission_set.id = user_permission_set.permission_set_id AND permission_set.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE user_permission_set.user_id = user_account.id ), '未設定') AS permission_set_display, user_account.cognito_sub AS cognito_sub, user_account.is_deleted AS is_deleted, user_account.created_at AS created_at, user_account.updated_at AS updated_at
LEFT JOIN companies company ON company.id = user_account.company_id LEFT JOIN departments department ON department.id = user_account.department_id

SELECT user_account.id AS id, user_account.company_id AS company_id, user_account.department_id AS department_id, user_account.username AS username, user_account.name AS name, user_account.email AS email, user_account.actor_type AS actor_type, CASE WHEN user_account.company_id IS NULL THEN 'WorkOps' ELSE company.name END AS company_name, user_account.cognito_sub AS cognito_sub FROM users user_account LEFT JOIN companies company ON company.id = user_account.company_id WHERE user_account.id = #{userId} AND user_account.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT user_account.id AS id, user_account.company_id AS company_id, user_account.department_id AS department_id, user_account.username AS username, user_account.name AS name, user_account.email AS email, user_account.actor_type AS actor_type, company.name AS company_name, user_account.cognito_sub AS cognito_sub FROM users user_account INNER JOIN companies company ON company.id = user_account.company_id WHERE user_account.id = #{userId} AND user_account.is_deleted = FALSE AND user_account.actor_type = 'TENANT' AND user_account.company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT permission_set.code FROM user_permission_sets user_permission_set INNER JOIN permission_sets permission_set ON permission_set.id = user_permission_set.permission_set_id AND permission_set.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE user_permission_set.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY permission_set.id ASC
SELECT company.id AS id, company.code AS code, company.name AS name FROM companies company WHERE company.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY company.code ASC, company.id ASC

SELECT department.id AS id, department.company_id AS company_id, company.code AS company_code, department.name AS name FROM departments department INNER JOIN companies company ON company.id = department.company_id AND company.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE department.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY company.code ASC, department.code ASC, department.id ASC

SELECT department.id AS id, department.company_id AS company_id, company.code AS company_code, department.name AS name FROM departments department INNER JOIN companies company ON company.id = department.company_id AND company.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE department.is_deleted = FALSE AND department.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY department.code ASC, department.id ASC
SELECT company.id FROM companies company WHERE company.id = #{companyId} AND company.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT permission_set.code AS code, permission_set.name AS name FROM permission_sets permission_set WHERE permission_set.code = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' AND permission_set.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY permission_set.id ASC

SELECT permission_set.code AS code, permission_set.name AS name FROM permission_sets permission_set WHERE permission_set.code IN ('TENANT_VIEWER', 'TENANT_EDITOR', 'TENANT_MANAGER') AND permission_set.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY permission_set.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET name = #{name}, email = #{email}, department_id = #{departmentId}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_account.id) FROM users user_account INNER JOIN user_permission_sets user_permission_set ON user_permission_set.user_id = user_account.id INNER JOIN permission_sets permission_set ON permission_set.id = user_permission_set.permission_set_id AND permission_set.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE user_account.company_id = #{companyId} AND user_account.actor_type = 'TENANT' AND user_account.is_deleted = FALSE AND permission_set.code = 'TENANT_MANAGER'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( company_id, department_id, cognito_sub, username, name, email, actor_type, is_deleted, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{departmentId}, #{cognitoSub}, #{username}, #{name}, #{email}, #{actorType}, FALSE, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )

INSERT INTO user_permission_sets ( user_id, permission_set_id ) SELECT #{userId}, permission_set.id FROM permission_sets permission_set WHERE permission_set.code = #{permissionSetCode} AND permission_set.is_deleted = FALSE
